criteria.criterion: The footer has a top border using var(--border-hairline) as the width and var(--border-subtle) as the color, and no other decoration (no background, box-shadow, or border-radius).
criteria.evidence: apps/connect/styles.css lines 128-131: `.site-footer { margin-top: var(--control-px-lg); padding-top: var(--space-3); border-top: var(--border-hairline) solid var(--border-subtle); }`. No background, box-shadow, or border-radius property present in the rule. Source-level only; not confirmed rendered (preview unreachable).

criteria.criterion: The footer's text is styled with font-size: var(--text-caption) and font-weight: var(--weight-regular), and no other font-size or font-weight rule applies to it.
criteria.evidence: apps/connect/styles.css lines 133-135: `.site-footer .caption { font-size: var(--text-caption); font-weight: var(--weight-regular); }`. Ran `grep -n "caption" apps/connect/styles.css` — the only other reference to 'caption' in the file is this new rule; no pre-existing `.caption` class exists. Checked the `body` rule (styles.css lines 42-46) and the universal `*` reset (line 40) for competing font-size/font-weight declarations — neither sets either property, so no other rule applies. Source-level only; not confirmed rendered (preview unreachable).

criteria.criterion: The footer's spacing (its margin above the rule and padding between the rule and the text) uses only token values already defined in apps/connect/styles.css's :root block (e.g. var(--space-3), var(--control-px-lg)) — no new pixel literals anywhere in the diff.
criteria.evidence: `.site-footer` uses `margin-top: var(--control-px-lg)` and `padding-top: var(--space-3)`; both custom properties are pre-existing entries in the :root block (styles.css lines 16 and 24, confirmed via grep). evidence/app-diff.txt shows no raw pixel literals in any added line — every new declaration references a var(--...) token.
